text.p: Following are French first division matches scheduled this weekend (standings in brackets):

Arguably the leaders' toughest away game to date against side that scored four at Lens on Wednesday. But PSG forwards, especially Panamanian Julio Cesar Dely Valdes, are in scoring form. Home side rested several in midweek in preparation for PSG visit.

On paper easy game for Monaco, often more comfortable away, and one they will want to win as booster ahead of first leg of UEFA Cup third-round tie at home to Hamburg on Tuesday. Caen are unbeaten in three games.

The champions, who have not won in their last two matches, will want good away performance ahead of European Cup trip to Ajax Amsterdam on Wednesday. Rennes, only side to have beaten PSG, have taken 20 of their 22 points at home.
Metz, who face Newcastle United in UEFA Cup at home on Tuesday, can extend winning streak to four games with victory. Bastia have failed to score in three of last four home games.

Marseille will be without out-of-favour Bulgarian Yordan Lechkov and Tony Cascarino of Ireland as well as suspended Italian Ivan Franceschini, sent off in Wednesday's 0-0 draw at Cannes, but captain Jean-Philippe Durand returns after injury. Lens, depleted by injuries, have lost last two matches.
Brittany derby in which Nantes will be aiming to go 11 games unbeaten with defender Laurent Guyot back from injury against side without a goal in three games.

Cannes have not scored in last four games even if they have only condeded two goals in same period and have fourth best defence. Strasbourg, with most victories apart from top two teams, have won last five at home.
Nice have picked up only two points from last seven games since crashing 7-0 at Nantes on October 5. Le Havre are unbeaten in last three away games.
Montpellier's second relegation-zone clash in row after 0-0 draw with Caen in midweek.

Home side confident of getting back on track after defeat at PSG in midweek. "In Paris, we saw the difference between a side that won the (European) Cup Winners' Cup and a team under construction." Lyon have conceded 14 goals in last three away matches.
